dataset: ICDAR 2015 SmartDoc Challenge 1 original sample dataset
author_attribution: Jean-Christophe Burie, Joseph Chazalon, Mickaël Coustaty, Sébastien Eskenazi, Muhammad Muzzamil Luqman, Maroua Mehri, Nibal Nayef, Jean-Marc OGIER, Sophea Prum and Marçal Rusinol. ICDAR2015 Competition on Smartphone Document Capture and OCR (SmartDoc). ICDAR, 2015.
capture_method: Document model printed on A4 paper and filmed handheld using Google Nexus 7, per original dataset authors. Selected frames show the same physical datasheet under natural capture variation.
transform: Native video-frame decode to lossless PNG. This selection retains original frame composition and pixels after decode.
selection_scope: Four selected frames from one original video. The recapture workflow replays successive dataset observations using an automated uploader.
ground_truth_corners: Original quadrilateral annotations are distributed in the official full archive.
